2/9/92 - featured a 'Special Report' segment where it was announced that Bret Hart would face the winner of the SNME Piper / Mountie IC Title match at WrestleMania VIII; included last week's Funeral Parlor segment from WWF Superstars with Sensational Sherri; featured closing comments from WWF World Champion Ric Flair, Mr. Perfect, the Undertaker, Paul Bearer, and Hulk Hogan regarding their upcoming tag team match at SNME:
Hulk Hogan Interview
Interview w/ Ric Flair, Mr. Perfect, And Bobby Heenan After The Royal Rumble Match (From Royal Rumble)

2/16/92 - featured footage from last week's Saturday Night's Main Event of the Hogan & Sid / Flair & Undertaker match to begin the broadcast; footage was also shown listed as airing the following day of Justice as a guest of the Barber Shop in which Justice attacked Beefcake and destroyed the Barber Shop set with a chair (final Barber Shop segment); included a 'Special Report' segment where it was announced that Hulk Hogan would face Sid Justice at WrestleMania VIII, not WWF World Champion Ric Flair, and that Flair would now defend against the new #1 contender Randy Savage, with speculation that a special referee was likely to be assigned for the Hogan / Justice match; featured comments from Flair & Mr. Perfect regarding Flair's match with Savage, with Flair stating he and Perfect knew something that Savage didn't know:

3/22/92 - featured Gene Okerlund interviewing WWF World Champion Ric Flair & Mr. Perfect on Flair's boat where the champion revealed more photos from WWF Magazine featuring him with Miss Elizabeth; included a 'Special Report' segment showing last week's altercation between Sid Justice and Virgil on WWF Superstars; there were rumors during the entirety of the program that Hogan's match at WrestleMania would be his last but that was not confirmed nor denied:

3/8/92 - included Gene Okerlund conducting an interview with Jake Roberts, discussing his match with the Undertaker at WrestleMania VIII; featured a 'Special Report' segment showing this week's interview from WWF Superstars with Ric Flair:

3/15/92 - featured Gene Okerlund conducting a podium interview with WWF IC Champion Roddy Piper and Bret Hart, with both sitting on the edge of the platform for the interview, with Piper saying he doesn't want to fight Bret at WrestleMania VIII and Bret then telling him that if he doesn't then the title will be Bret's anyway; both men then stood up and Piper offered to shake Bret's hand and the fight would be on, Bret then shook his hand and turned his back, with Piper then motioning he would hit Bret with the title belt and then saying he could have taken him out if he had wanted to; included footage from the WrestleMania VIII press conference from Indianapolis in which the two main events were officially announced, with brief clips of a verbal confrontation between Hulk Hogan and Sid Justice; featured a pre- interview between Vince McMahon and WWF World Champion Ric Flair at a restaurant, with Flair debuting new pictures of he and Miss Elizabeth; included footage from Randy Savage's reaction to the pictures, with Savage repeating "Not true" and nothing more:
Jake The Snake Roberts Interview

3/29/92 - included a 'Special Report' segment with footage from a press conference held by WWF World Champion Ric Flair & Mr. Perfect in an empty room; Flair had with him a scarf he said belonged to Miss Elizabeth, which appeared in one of the photos with Flair & Elizabeth together, and said he would wear it at WrestleMania:

4/5/92 - included a Special Report segment showing Miss Elizabeth's interview from the previous week's March to WrestleMania VIII; featured Gene Okerlund conducting an interview with WWF World Champion Ric Flair & Mr. Perfect at an airport, during which they said they would reveal a centerfold of Elizabeth at WrestleMania; included an ad promoting the upcoming WBF Superstars show, which would feature Lex Luger; featured a closing segment focusing on the career of Hulk Hogan and his WrestleMania matches against Andre the Giant and the Ultimate Warrior:
